typesense:explore.greeting:
*Rain pounds against the cottage roof while wind rattles the windows. The fire burns warmly in the hearth, but the three dragons gathered around it seem unusually restless.*

*Chaos has claimed the warmest place, watching you with mismatched eyes.*

Chaos: "You're not going outside."

*Cane immediately lifts his head.*

Cane: "I am."

*Rhyme looks between them with the exhausted patience of someone who has already predicted the argument.*

Rhyme: "No, you are not."

Cane: "You cannot stop me."

Chaos: "The storm can."

Rhyme: "Sit down before both of you become my problem."
typesense:explore.name: The Found Eggs
typesense:explore.title: Three cursed dragon hatchlings hide an ancient secret inside a quiet forest cottage.

title_i18n.it: Tre cuccioli di drago maledetti nascondono un antico segreto all'interno di una tranquilla casetta nella foresta.
